chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān and Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Ibn Muskān, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “If you doubt concerning the first two rakʿahs, then repeat.”

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: title of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام in this narration
key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs, meaning two units of salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَأَعِدْ: then repeat, i.e. perform the salat (prayer) again

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts in the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer). It states that if doubt occurs in the first two rakʿahs, the prayer must be repeated, showing the special legal weight of certainty in the foundational units of the prayer.
